summary: Strengthen lease, facilities, and asset reporting skills in this practical five-day course. Explore the outline and plan your training.
lede: Overseeing commercial buildings involves coordinating leases, facilities operations, tenant services, and asset reporting. This course is for property managers, facilities professionals, and real estate analysts who need to review lease records, prioritize maintenance work, reconcile service-charge data, and report occupancy and operating performance using Excel and Power BI.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage commercial buildings, leases, facilities, tenant services, and property performance reporting.
modules: Commercial Property Dashboards and Action Plans
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working familiarity with commercial property, real estate operations, lease administration, or facilities management. You should be comfortable reading basic lease and property operating records. No coding or programming is required.
